scope: Exact recovered BU merged checkpoint loader bridge; no provider or model calls performed by this review
checkpoint_weight_provenance: Caller must verify the exact merged shards against runs/pilot-v1-remote-report.json; metadata pins alone do not authenticate weight contents.
normalization: num_local_experts 128 becomes num_experts 128; HF4 constructor default is not accepted.
rope_parameters is serialized as rope_theta 5000000 plus rope_scaling preserving interleaving, sections, and type.
text_config.tie_word_embeddings becomes false, matching top-level conditional-model semantics and separate checkpoint lm_head.
vision model_type spelling becomes qwen3_vl_moe, as in exact cached HF4 base metadata.
Producer transformers_version remains historical 5.10.2; do not present it as active runtime.
The extra merged sliding_window:null is retained; original cached config omits that disabled option.

loader_method.insertion: Outer Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration.load_weights, before inherited AutoWeightsLoader prefix mapping
loader_method.transformation: Every packed expert tensor becomes per-expert gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj 2D views. No transpose, arithmetic, copy, or cast.

runner_requirements: Set VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 before importing vLLM; distributed_executor_backend=uni; tensor/pipeline/data parallel sizes=1; quantization=None.
Create an ephemeral metadata overlay with normalized config and readonly-source shard/index symlinks; do not rewrite original config or model shards.
Install hook before LLM construction; tokenizer/processor/template must be from pinned cached BU artifacts.
Read model._bu_merged_compat_receipt via LLM.apply_model and require complete=true before using the model.
Set enforce_eager=True, max_num_seqs=1, prefix caching disabled, and bound context plus image/video allowance explicitly.
Before any in-place weight edit, require no unfinished requests; clear prefix cache after edits and handle preprocessing warmup consistently across timing comparisons.
Re-establish the baseline under the new serving stack; TF pilot failure and later vLLM performance cannot isolate a weight-edit effect.

attention_proxy.requirements: Check actual names, shape, dtype, no quantization, TP=1, disjoint q/k/v row slices, unique originals, and immutable per-variant reconstruction.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_vllm018_compat.py -v
tests.scope: Small NumPy indexing, shared storage, pinned saved metadata normalization and invalid/incomplete/duplicate metadata or iterator rejection.
tests.history: Initial comparison test exposed retained sliding_window:null versus absent cached-base key; the test now checks that null explicitly before semantic comparison. No production helper change was needed.
tests.portability: Private-metadata tests skip when preflight evidence is absent. Three NumPy view tests skip when optional NumPy is unavailable; metadata rejection test has no external dependency.

sources.basis: Packed loader implicit transpose; per-expert branch; inner text config and head tying.
Inherited raw-HF prefix mapper and AutoWeightsLoader; multimodal processing.
Ordinary expert mapping; qkv/o projection dimensions; RoPE parameters.
Per-expert gate/up/down mappings to fused w13/w2 weights.
HF4 num_experts and legacy rotary config schema.
Actual packed expert tensor ordering and independent conditional lm_head.
HF4 rotary config normalization into rope_parameters.
InprocClient constructs EngineCore in current process.
Local worker construction and load_model call.
